24                SENATOR LATIMER:   Thank you, 

25   Mr. President.  


                                                                726

 1                I intend to vote no on this bill, 

 2   and I want to explain the reasons why.  

 3                I'm concerned any time I see an 

 4   automatic forfeiture of a seat.  The 

 5   gubernatorial appointments on these boards 

 6   obviously should have a good attendance record.  

 7   There is a clause by which a chair may excuse 

 8   them.  But an automatic forfeiture concerns me.  

 9   I'd much rather see provisions that allow for a 

10   process to have an appointee who hasn't shown 

11   attendance to have the seat rescinded, without 

12   making it an automatic forfeiture.  

13                So with that thought in mind, my 

14   vote will be no on this bill.
